metric: the corrected primordial metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2; SPEC section 1)
assumptions: The Kohn-Sham states are the instantaneous (adiabatic) states of the record on the PRESCRIBED history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^{(4/3) H x4}; the cutoff L = 3, the fold convention and the filling convention of Revision/kohn_sham.

Part D replaces the x0-dependent source by its x0 average per proper volume (a dimensional reduction, an APPROXIMATION: C1 and B3 show that the true source is not x0-independent) and uses the free gas (lambda = 0), whose average is exact for every (a4, b4) while it stays on the fold band (D0).
The gravity theories and their couplings are the stated ones; kappa and, except for the author's weights, Lambda are fixed by the constraint at x4 = 0.
conclusions: No recorded Kohn-Sham state is an admissible source of the corrected metric: every nonzero state depends on x0 (B3), and the interacting states violate p0 = p_t also after averaging (C1); the off-diagonal condition holds.
The free (lambda = 0) gas is an exact fold-band gas: averaged over x0 it is rho_bar = C b4^{-2}, p3 = rho/3, p0 = p_t = 0, a source that conserves energy for every a4, b4 (A5, D0).

The record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^{(4/3) H x4} needs a source that changes sign along it (A6, C3); the Kohn-Sham gas does not supply it: the history is a prescribed background without back-reaction.
With the averaged free gas as the source, the x0-averaged equations started on the record's history evolve differently (D2, D4; outcomes in results/ks-source-a4-cases.csv).

checks.name: A1_hidden_equals_extra_times_and_no_offdiagonal
checks.detail: a4-equations.json has one component for x0 = x5 = x6 = x7 (generalSource.hiddenEqualsExtraTimes: 'kappa (p0 - p_t) = 0: p0 = p_t'), so a source needs p0 = p_t; the off-diagonal left-hand sides vanish identically (generalSource.offDiagonal), so it needs T^x4_x0 = 0; the left-hand sides are free of x0 (generalSource.x0_dependence), so every component of the source must be independent of x0; the right-hand sides are -kappa rho, kappa p3, kappa p0: True; the Einstein entries of the record equal the general components at alpha2 = alpha3 = 0: True

checks.name: A2_constraint_first_order_second_order_system
checks.detail: the x4 component contains neither a4'' nor v = u' (a first-order constraint): True; the x1 and x0 components are linear in (a4'', v): True, with the Jacobian of generalSource.secondOrderJacobian: True (where det J != 0 they give a4'' and v from the sources)

checks.name: A3_constraint_propagation
checks.detail: d/dx4 [x4 component] = 3 a4' (x1 - x4) + 4 h4 (x0 - x4) identically for every alpha_k, Lambda (h4 = u/2 - a4', kk' = kk (2 a4' - u); generalSource.constraint_propagation): the constraint is preserved by the second-order system whenever the source satisfies the energy exchange (A5)

checks.name: A5_free_fold_band_gas_conserves_energy
checks.detail: generalSource.energyExchange (-d4 rho - 3 a4' (p3 + rho) - 4 h4 (p0 + rho) = 0 for an x0-independent source with p0 = p_t) holds identically for rho ~ b4^{-2} (d4 rho = -2 u rho), p3 = rho/3, p0 = p_t = 0, for every a4(x4) and b4(x4): the x0-averaged free fold-band gas (check D0) is a source that keeps the constraint (A3)

checks.detail: on the record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^((4/3) H x4) (a4' = H, a4'' = 0, u = (4/3) H, v = 0) the left-hand sides with the author's weights (Lambda removed) equal exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource_kappaT_minus_Lam (minus_rho, p3, p0 = pt; H = 1): True

checks.detail: p0_y + 3 H (p0 - p_t) = 0 (check A4) evaluated with 4th-order differences on the output grid (dy = 0.02) of the 70 nonzero profiles: largest residual relative to the largest term 1.21233e-05 (N8_lamm1_a20; tolerance 0.001 from the truncation). The recorded states CONSERVE energy-momentum along x0; the source fails the field equations because its components depend on x0 (B3) and, for lambda != 0, because p0 != p_t (C1), not because conservation fails

checks.detail: the field equations require every component of the source to be independent of x0 (A1); the profiles are not. The L1 measure with the volume weight, mu1_X = int e^{3Hy} |X - X_bar| / int e^{3Hy} |X| (0 for an x0-independent X), over the 70 nonzero states: mu1_rho in [0.147738, 0.738255] (smallest N8_lamm2_a00), mu1_p3 in [0.265725, 1.70454], mu1_p0 in [0.500885, 1.13418], mu1_p_t in [0.624773, 1.70492] (p0 = p_t = 0 identically for lambda = 0, where these two are undefined): the computed source is NOT close to an x0-independent one

checks.detail: dE/da4 = -3 P3 + P_t + P0/3 (beta = 4/3; ks-theory.json emt.energyChange; P = 2 Vol_7 int e^{3Hy} p dy) along the dense history (41 slices, every one of the 15 series; the occupations stay fixed along each, ks-history-run.json): Simpson of the right-hand side over two steps (0.1 in a4) against the change of E_KS, 300 intervals, largest |difference|/max(1, |E|) 4.27528e-09 (N8_lamp2 a4 = 0; tolerance 1e-05 from the quadrature)

checks.name: C3_record_history_not_sourced_by_the_gas
checks.detail: with the author's weights (Lambda = -10) the record's history needs kappa rho = 3.57407 at a4 = 0 and -7.63383 at a4 = 2 (exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource_kappaT_minus_Lam; it changes sign between the dense slices a4 = 0.75 and 0.8), while the x0-averaged Kohn-Sham energy density of the free gas N = 2352 is positive at every slice (rho_bar = 0.216249 at a4 = 0, 0.00104404 at a4 = 2): kappa = (needed kappa rho)/rho_bar would have to run from 16.5276 to -7311.81 along the history, no constant kappa makes the gas the source (with lambda != 0, C1 excludes it already)

checks.name: C4_source_signs
checks.detail: the gas of N = 592, 2352 (the fold band and the zero modes) has rho_bar > 0 and rho_bar + p3_bar > 0 in all 50 nonzero states. The 20 nonzero N = 8 states fill only k = 0 levels (no 3-momentum, so p3 = e_int, the interaction energy density; to first order in lambda, where S = 0, rho_bar and p3_bar both equal -lambda <n^2>/32): rho_bar has the sign of -lambda and the self-consistent p3_bar/rho_bar lies in [0.949561, 0.998955], so for lambda > 0 the averaged null energy condition along 3-space is VIOLATED (rho_bar + p3_bar < 0) in 10 states (N8_lamp1_a00, N8_lamp1_a05, N8_lamp1_a10, N8_lamp1_a15, N8_lamp1_a20, N8_lamp2_a00, N8_lamp2_a05, N8_lamp2_a10, N8_lamp2_a15, N8_lamp2_a20); for lambda = 0, p3_bar = rho_bar/3 exactly and p0_bar = p_t_bar = 0 (D0)

checks.name: D0_free_gas_average_exact
checks.detail: the x0-averaged free gas (lambda = 0, N = 592, 2352) along the dense history (82 states): rho_bar b4^2 is constant, p3_bar = rho_bar/3 and p0_bar = p_t_bar = 0, to 2.88658e-15. Reason (ks-theory.json blockEquation): every occupied orbital is the fold-band orbital (e^{f M y}, 0) with eps = e^{-a4} |k|, so E = e^{-a4} E(0) for EVERY (a4, b4) (f does not enter), and the proper cell volume is ell^3 v_t e^{-a4} b4^2 2W: rho_bar = C b4^{-2} with C = E(0)/(2 ell^3 v_t W) (N = 592, 2352: C = 0.034125, 0.216249) as long as the gas stays on the fold band (the Fermi level e^{-a4} k_F below the bulk edge, which depends on f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2}). So the averaged free gas is a source of the x0-averaged equations for any history
